% Parts in an article: in the running text, flush left, with the label in
% \Large and the title in \huge, 4ex above and 3ex below, and an unnumbered
% part.
\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
Some text before the first part.
\part{Beginnings}
\section{A section}
Some text in the section.
\part*{An unnumbered part}
More text.
\end{document}
